request: Track returnable containers: container number, container type (pallet, drum or tote), the customer holding it and the date it went out. A container is In yard, Out with customer, or Lost.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Returnable container" with 4 fields:
  - State (one of "In yard", "Out with customer", "Lost", required)
  - Container number (text, required)
  - Container type (one of "Pallet", "Drum", "Tote", required)
  - Date out (date)
  Records are shared by all companies in this tenant.
  It gets its own menu entry "Returnable container" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Returnable container records.
New optional link "Customer" from Returnable container to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Returnable container. Records start at "In yard".
  - Send out changes "In yard" to "Out with customer" after confirmation.
  - Return to yard changes "Out with customer" to "In yard" after confirmation.
  - Mark lost changes "Out with customer" to "Lost" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, 2 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
